requirements.description: Is it true that l(n) n^{-1/2} -> infinity? (answer: yes)
requirements.evidence: Erdos790.erdos_790_part_i proves Tendsto (l n / sqrt n) atTop atTop; AuditBridge.intended restates it with inline definitions.

requirements.description: Is it true that l(n) < n^{1-c} for some c > 0? (answer: no)
requirements.evidence: Erdos790.erdos_790_part_ii proves the negation of (exists c > 0, eventually l n < n^(1-c)); AuditBridge.intended restates it inline.

requirements.description: Estimate l(n): Korsky lower bound c n/(log n)^2 and l(n) = n^{1+o(1)}
requirements.evidence: Erdos790.korsky: exists c > 0, forall n >= 2, c n/(log n)^2 <= l n; Erdos790.erdos_790_exponent: log l(n)/log n -> 1.
